# Introduction and Overview

In this assignment, the sentiment analysis will be performed in two steps.

In the first, an example workflow from Chapter 2 of *Text Mining with R* will be replicated @silge2017text [Chapter 2]. The original code and dataset can be accessed in the online book at [tidytextmining.com/sentiment](https://www.tidytextmining.com/sentiment.html).

Then, the analysis will be extended to analyze a different text corpus, specifically the sentiment of WNBA fans in the WNBA subreddit [@r_wnba]. The `RedditExtractoR` package will be utilized to source the raw comment data, which was developed by @redditextractor.

# Approach

1.  Replicate example workflow from Chapter 2 of *Text Mining with R*

2.  Source raw r\\WNBA comment data using `RedditExtractoR`

3.  Apply new sentiment lexicons

    1.  VADER

4.  Analyze WNBA comment data to identify trends in 2026 Playoffs
